preserved_scope.target: Model number of trials until conditioned responding across ITIs 30, 60, 300, 600 and 3,600 seconds. This source model endpoint is one part of the paper’s behavior/dopamine learning claims.
preserved_scope.full_panel: Preserve the registered original behavioral/dopamine learning programme, not only the 60/600-second reconstruction or five-ITI AIC scalar: original five-ITI behavior, 60/600/3600 dopamine, model comparisons and all required companions in Figures 1-8, Extended Data 1-10, Supplementary Note 1 and Table 1, including corrected Fig4b, histology/exclusion mapping, onset/peak sensitivities, aversive spacing, four alternative-explanation controls, partial reinforcement, omission timing and model extensions. Complete immutable animal/session/model/figure membership and source-native curve/parameter outputs are not authenticated.
preserved_scope.qualification: Preserve the prior broad scalar inventory as source evidence without making every item a mandatory primary gate. Figure 5 five-ITI behavioral model fitting is genuine empirical modeling and can support its own interpretation; it does not substitute for the reward-spacing behavioral/dopamine primary.
preserved_scope.accepted_retained_associated_scope:
empirical_modeling_component: Figure 5's five-ITI trials-to-learn comparison is genuine modeling of real behavioral observations using TDRL, SOP and ANCCR simulations. Retain complete selected source conditions, log-RSS selection and separately reported AIC variants; fit quality cannot substitute for biological or dopamine reproduction.
interpretive_model_control: Original model comparisons remain companion evidence when the named mechanistic interpretation requires them; they are not universally compulsory for every narrower empirical result.
prospective_extension: New animal-held-out splits, rewritten penalties, new learning metrics or newly selected candidate-model evaluation policies remain extensions and require separate scientific justification.

source_authority.primary_scope: Named central reward-spacing effects on behavioral learning and dopamine, with elapsed-time-versus-trial-count comparisons and source-specific controls. The retained next action names one matched contrast whose exact panel remains unbound; no automatic all-18-figure or whole-paper requirement.

qualification: Preserved bytes are source evidence and provenance, not a second active reproduction contract. Their earlier scope or criteria do not override the accepted active scope. No empirical execution, scientific success, paired outcome admission or identity release is established.
